<thought>All subnetworks are already connected via the intermediate nodes X1, X2, X3, and the terminal nodes A and B. I just need to merge the resistor dictionaries and connection lists, giving each resistor a unique identifier (by prefixing with the subnet number). The combined topology is therefore a single JSON object containing all 13 resistors and their connections.</thought>
<final_answer>{"resistors": {"S1_R1": 2.222, "S1_R2": 4.445, "S2_R1": 5.0, "S2_R2": 10.0, "S2_R3": 15.0, "S2_R4": 20.0, "S3_R1": 5.0, "S3_R2": 10.0, "S3_R3": 15.0, "S3_R4": 20.0, "S4_R1": 20.0, "S4_R2": 15.0, "S4_R3": 10.0}, "connections": [["A","N1","S1_R1"], ["N1","X1","S1_R2"], ["X1","N_b1","S2_R1"], ["N_b1","N_b2","S2_R2"], ["N_b2","N_b3","S2_R3"], ["N_b3","X2","S2_R4"], ["X2","N_c1","S3_R1"], ["N_c1","N_c2","S3_R2"], ["N_c2","N_c3","S3_R3"], ["N_c3","X3","S3_R4"], ["B","N_d2","S4_R1"], ["N_d2","N_d1","S4_R2"], ["N_d1","X3","S4_R3"]]}</final_answer>
